title: feat(actiongroup): migrate action group (#6444)
evidence:
Add the 2nd-gen `<swc-action-group>` file structure, API, accessibility semantics, and Spectrum 2 styling, migrated from the Spectrum 1 `<sp-action-group>`.

- **API**: `accessible-label`, `disabled`, `orientation` (`horizontal` / `vertical`), `compact`, `quiet`, `justified`, `size`, `static-color`;
